parties.petitioner: M/S Larsen Air Conditioning And Refrigration Company

summary: Arbitration interest rate modification; pre-amended Section 31(7)(b) mandates 18% statutory interest; High Court improperly reduced to 9% simple interest; scope of judicial interference under Section 34 limited to grounds specified; arbitral award final per GCC Clause 70; Shahi case precedent affirms statutory rate; Article 142 jurisdiction factors distinguished from Kalsi case; appeal allowed to reinstate 18% compound interest.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment modified to reinstate 18% compound interest as per arbitral award; reduction to 9% simple interest set aside.
